## Install

| Where you use AI | What to do |
|---|---|
| Claude app (web, desktop, mobile) | Download **security-foundations-skill.zip** below. In Claude, open Settings → Capabilities → Skills → Upload skill. |
| Gemini (web, Mac app) | Unzip **security-foundations-skill.zip**, then in Gemini open Settings → Skills and import `SKILL.md`. Call it with `@security-foundations`. |
| Claude Code | `/plugin marketplace add LYNGMN/security-foundations-plugin` then `/plugin install security-foundations@security-foundations-marketplace` |
| ChatGPT | Download **security-foundations-chatgpt-plugin.zip** below. At chatgpt.com/plugins choose Add → upload the archive → Install plugin. |
| Other chat tools, Gemini Gems | **security-foundations-instructions-kit.zip**: paste-in instructions and knowledge files. |
| Gemini CLI | `gemini extensions install https://github.com/LYNGMN/security-foundations-plugin` |
| Codex | See the [README](https://github.com/LYNGMN/security-foundations-plugin#codex). |

Step-by-step guides: [English](https://github.com/LYNGMN/security-foundations-plugin#readme) · [한국어](https://github.com/LYNGMN/security-foundations-plugin/blob/main/README.ko.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/LYNGMN/security-foundations-plugin/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) · [日本語](https://github.com/LYNGMN/security-foundations-plugin/blob/main/README.ja.md)

Assets are built by GitHub Actions and carry a build provenance attestation. Verify with `gh attestation verify <file> --repo LYNGMN/security-foundations-plugin`.
